correctness.rationale: The two-token graph has three independent layers. For every maximal independent set, letting A and B be endpoint supports of the same-side selected pairs forces exactly the entire mixed rectangle (X\A)x(Y\B). A nonempty rectangle forces all same-side pairs on A and B; an empty one forces every same-side pair. Both forms are independent and dominating, so the classification is necessary, sufficient, and unique. Counting complement supports proves the complete polynomial and total count. The exact identity binom(a,2)+binom(b,2)+(m-a)(n-b)=binom(m,2)+(m-a)(n-m)+(b-m+a)(b-m+a-1)/2 gives a sharp minimum and exhaustive equality case counts; boundary m=n=2 is handled. The package standalone verifier independently builds the token-move graph and enumerates all MIS via complement cliques for m,n<=5, checks the all-set classification on m,n<=7, and checks minimum counts to m<=7,n<10. No finite check is mistaken for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete size enumerator of all facets of the independence complex of F_2(K_{m,n}) is a natural full-family invariant not determined by the known independence number, ordinary domination number, or non-well-coveredness. The structural rectangle bijection reduces exponentially many token configurations to two endpoint subsets and yields both an exact product count and independent domination numbers with all minimum-set multiplicities. All sizes and all two-part parameters are covered, without arbitrary finite cutoffs.
